title: うさぎとかめ (Usagi to Kame — The Hare and the Tortoise)
description: A four-verse children's song adapting Aesop's fable of the tortoise and the hare. The hare taunts the tortoise for being slow; the tortoise challenges the hare to a race to the foot of the mountain; the overconfident hare takes a nap (グーグーグー); the hare wakes too late and loses. Teaches perseverance. Published 1901. Lyrics: 石原和三郎 (Ishihara Wasaburō, d.1922), music: 納所弁次郎 (Nōsho Benjirō, d.1936). Both PD confirmed.
